title: One shared story page_op slot: a concurrent story-page request replaces the tracked op, so the earlier op's failure or success is never shown
trigger: On a chat's story page, delete or rename an album (page_op = Sending), then scroll the archive or posted list so a paging read starts (begin_story_page_check replaces page_op); the delete answer arrives with an error.
effect: story_page_op_for matches only the latest request id, so the error is dropped silently: no failed line, as if the delete worked. The archive/posted 'loading' indicator is also lost when an album op overwrites the Checking op.
fix: Track story-page ops per request (map keyed by RequestId, or one enum value per op kind), and keep the loading state of reads separate from the status line of mutations.

title: send_story_page overwrites page_op with Failed on a send error, replacing whichever other page op was in flight
trigger: A story page read is in flight; a second page request fails to send (AgentDriving or Native).
effect: The in-flight op's tracking is lost, so its answer no longer clears or settles the page status.
fix: Same per-request op map as the page_op entry.

title: Re-requesting insights while statistics are in flight fetches the first forwards page again and appends it
trigger: Open insights for own story A; its forwards page answers first; reopen insights for A while getStoryStatistics is still pending.
effect: The pending-stats branch sees no forwards request in flight and calls fetch_story_public_forwards(offset empty); accept_public_forwards extends the list, so the first page of public forwards shows twice.
fix: Ask for the first page only when the forwards fetch is Idle; make forwards a Fetch with the offset it was asked for and replace on offset 0.

title: postStory answer and error are matched by purpose only, not to the composer that posted
trigger: Press Post in the story composer, close it before the answer, open the composer again (ui/story_composer.rs:185-187 resets eligibility, check_error and outcome to None); the first postStory then answers (outcome becomes Posting{id}) or errors (outcome becomes Failed).
effect: The new composer shows 'Posting failed' or Posted/busy for a post it did not make; post_sent clears because outcome left None.
fix: Key StoryPostOutcome by the postStory request id (Posting{request,story_id}) and apply Failed/Succeeded only when it is the current composer's request.

title: A 400 from getStory marks a story expired for the whole session
trigger: A story card or reply header asks getStory before its poster chat is loaded or while the story is not yet accessible; TDLib answers 400. Later the story becomes loadable (chat loads, user joins).
effect: missing holds the key forever (nothing removes it; reset_active_stories_paging clears only story_retry), the prefetch filter skips it and the card says 'This story has expired' until restart unless the story arrives through updateStory.
fix: Enum per story StoryFetch { Unasked, Asked, Waiting{until}, Gone } with a retry for 400 and a clear on new Ready/updateStory.

title: viewMessages ack is not matched to the request: commit_viewed/abort_viewing act on every id in `viewing` of the chat
trigger: Scroll a busy chat so two viewMessages requests (different ids) are in flight at once. The first answers ok: commit_viewed moves ALL `viewing` ids, including the second request's, into `viewed`. The second then fails (flood, network): abort_viewing finds `viewing` empty, so those ids are never re-sent. Same when an answer from before a chat re-open lands after the new open generation began viewing.
effect: Messages whose view failed stay marked viewed: the chat keeps its unread count/mentions/reactions until the chat is re-opened (viewed is cleared per open generation).
fix: Key the in-flight set by RequestId (and view_generation): `viewing: HashMap<RequestId, BTreeSet<i64>>`; commit/abort only the entry of the answering request and ignore an answer whose view_generation is not current.

title: A story-page op left Sending/Checking by a lost request is never settled
trigger: Start an album mutation or load, then the request is dropped without an answer or error reaching story_page_op_for (for example after reconnect); settle_story_page_op keeps in-flight ops
effect: The status line shows 'Sending'/'Checking' indefinitely until another op replaces it
fix: Give the op an owner-going-away exit: clear in-flight ops when the driver takes back a request, and when the page is left.

title: Story interactions answer is matched to story only, not to the request or offset that asked
trigger: Open viewers, scroll to load more (offset page N in flight), close and reopen the panel: clear_story_viewers + begin_story_viewers makes a fresh state; fetch of page 1 returns Ok(None) because has_purpose_for_story is still true; the old page-N answer then lands
effect: Page N rows are appended as the first rows of the fresh panel, next_offset jumps ahead, page 1 is never fetched, loading never set so no spinner
fix: Store the asking RequestId in the viewers Fetch stage and apply an answer only when it equals that id; the skip check compares the same key.

title: Story report answers are matched to (chat, story) only; stage and request are not checked
trigger: Start report on a story, close the report box, reopen it on the same story (begin_story_report resets to Checking) before the first answer; or a late answer arrives after Failed/Reported
effect: The old answer moves the new flow to a wrong stage (picker or Reported) while the new request is still in flight, then the second answer flips it again; a late Ok can mark a failed report as Reported
fix: Put the in-flight RequestId in the Checking and Sending variants and apply an answer or error only when it equals that id.

title: The story editor's Save reads the shared StoryManageState slot, so another call's outcome closes or fails it
trigger: Edit a posted story in the composer and press Save; while editStory is in flight, another management call takes the slot (the viewer's cover or privacy editor, or an album action that calls fail_locally).
effect: frame_upkeep clears save_sent when stories.manage.pending is false, without checking that the slot still holds this edit's request. The other call's result decides: its success closes the composer as saved while the edit may still fail silently, its failure shows its error in the composer.
fix: Keep the edit's RequestId in the composer (a Saving{request} stage) and settle it only from the answer to that request, not from the shared slot's pending flag.

title: bar_focused survives a chat switch, so the new chat's unread bar reads as focused
trigger: With a screen reader on, move accessibility focus onto the 'Unread messages' bar (Up from the first unread), then open another chat that has an unread divider.
effect: MessageUi.a11y.bar_focused is per window, not per chat (ChatUi is replaced by sync_chat_ui, MessageUi.a11y is not): history_a11y_row_focus reports the new chat's bar as focused and Space/play-pause is refused (bar_focused true) before the user focused anything there.
fix: Make the a11y focus one value in ChatUi (enum A11yFocus { None, Bar, Row(MessageId) }) replacing bar_focused + selection_focus pairing, so a chat change replaces it whole.

title: pinned_list_open is window-wide and not reset when the open chat changes
trigger: Open the pinned-messages list from the pinned bar in chat A, then click chat B (which has pinned messages) in the chat list.
effect: Chat B shows its pinned list panel open without being asked; in a chat with no pins the flag stays set and the list pops open later in the next chat with pins.
fix: Move the open flag into ChatUi (per chat) or into an enum PinnedBar { Bar, List } keyed by AccountChat so a chat change replaces it.

title: Strip wheel AxisLock never resets for a plain mouse wheel (no Started/Ended phases): the first event fixes the axis for the session of hovering
trigger: hover the strip with a mouse wheel and scroll vertically once, then Shift+wheel; or scroll horizontally first and then try to scroll the list vertically over the strip
effect: feed() keeps the decided axis until restart/Ended, which wheels never send: vertical wheel over the strip is either swallowed as sideways scroll or the strip never scrolls sideways
fix: for non-precise deltas decide per event (do not store the axis), reset on pointer leave

title: Cover picker marks the clip unreadable at open when it is not local yet and never re-checks
trigger: own video story whose clip is still downloading (or evicted): open the story menu, Choose cover
effect: picker shows 'unreadable' permanently even after the clip finishes downloading; user must close and reopen the picker
fix: CoverStage::WaitingForClip that re-resolves story_video_path each tick and moves to Probing once local

title: Cover Save and Privacy Save and composer Save-edit share the single StoryManageState slot; the first call's answer is dropped when another starts
trigger: save the cover, then (before the answer) save the privacy editor of the same story (both panels can be open at once)
effect: the cover call's answer no longer matches the slot, so cover_sent clears with the privacy call's result: the cover panel closes as saved (or shows the privacy error) though the cover edit may have failed
fix: key the in-flight management call by purpose (Cover|Privacy|Edit) per story, and let each panel hold its own RequestId instead of a sent bool matched to a global pending

title: Create album has no in-flight guard and does not clear the name; a second press creates a duplicate album
trigger: type an album name, press Create twice (or Create after choosing stories, then Create again)
effect: two albums with the same name; the name input still holds the old text
fix: disable story-page mutations while page_op is Sending for the page and clear new_album_name on success

title: Picker is closed before the create/add call is sent; a failed send loses the ticked stories
trigger: tick stories in the album picker, press Create/Save while the connection call fails (driver Err)
effect: picker is already gone (page.picker = None / close_album_picker) so the selection is lost; only an error note appears
fix: close the picker when the op settles Succeeded; keep it with the error on Failed

title: delete_story_album clears the confirm and leaves the album view even when the send failed
trigger: press Delete album twice in demo mode or when the driver rejects the call
effect: view returns to the album list as if deleted; the album is still there and no retry state is kept
fix: leave the album only when page_op for that request Succeeds

title: Pin/unpin builds the full pinned list from the cached state and sends it without waiting for the previous answer
trigger: pin story A and quickly pin story B (before the first setChatPinnedStories answers)
effect: second call carries the old list plus B only, so A's pin is overwritten and lost on the server
fix: disable pin toggles while a pin op is Sending, or queue and rebuild from the settled list

title: Archive/posted loading is read from the single session-wide page_op slot by label, not by chat or request
trigger: open the story page of chat A while its three loads fire, or leave A's page and open B quickly
effect: only the last of the three loads owns page_op, so chat_page_loading() is false while posted stories load and a second page can be asked; B's page can show 'loading' that belongs to A; viewer ops (hide, profile toggle, close friends) also overwrite the line
fix: per-chat Fetch<Page> for archive and posted lists keyed by (chat, purpose), leaving page_op for mutations only

title: canPostStory answer is session-wide and not matched to the composer/target that asked
trigger: press Post, close the composer, reopen it, pick a different Post as channel and press Post; the first answer lands now
effect: the earlier eligibility clears check_sent and posts to the newly chosen target chat with eligibility computed for another chat
fix: carry the checked target and RequestId in ComposerStage::Checking and apply only the matching answer

title: After a successful post the composer stays open with its media and Post enabled; a second press posts a duplicate story
trigger: post a story, see 'Posted', press Post again
effect: busy is false once outcome is Succeeded and post_sent is cleared, story_composer_post runs again and posts the same media a second time
fix: close the composer (or move to ComposerStage::Posted with Post disabled) on Succeeded

title: Opening one viewer panel leaves others open: stats closes only viewers/report, share closes only close-friends
trigger: open Share (or the privacy editor / cover picker), then press Statistics; or open Statistics then Share
effect: several panels (stats, share, privacy, cover) stack in story_action_row/story_more_row at once, pushing the story out of the 640px frame and each stealing the shared more_search field
fix: single ViewerPanel enum (see implicit-state entry) so opening one replaces the other

title: save_story_media copies the story file to Downloads synchronously on the UI thread
trigger: press Save media on a large video story
effect: UI freezes for the length of the copy (no progress, no way to cancel)
fix: run the copy on the background executor and show a Saving/Saved/Failed notice

title: close_friends_saving has no way out when the list was never loaded, or when page_op was replaced, or when the server list differs from the sent ids
trigger: open the editor with the list unloaded and press Save while the call fails; or Hide the peer while saving
effect: tick_close_friends returns on loaded==None before checking failed; saving stays true, Save is disabled and shows Saving forever (Cancel closes it)
fix: CloseFriendsStage::Saving(RequestId) left by the matching answer (ok/error) rather than by comparing lists

title: delete_confirm stays armed when the user opens the add-stories picker or another view, so the next click on Delete deletes at once
trigger: open an album, press Delete album (label turns to Confirm), press Add stories, Back from the picker
effect: the Delete button still reads Confirm delete; one click deletes the album without the intended second look
fix: enum AlbumView { List, Album{id, confirm_delete: bool}, Picker{..} } so changing the view resets the confirm

title: Activate Stealth Mode failure from TDLib gives no feedback and leaves the box open
trigger: tap Enable Stealth Mode when the server rejects it (flood wait, premium lapsed)
effect: box stays open on the same button; no error is shown because ActivateStoryStealthMode has no arm in apply_stories_error
fix: StealthBox stage Activating(RequestId) with an error arm that shows the reason and returns to Idle

title: A comment waiting for Stars is dropped when the Stars box sends the viewer to top up
trigger: Type a comment that needs more Stars than chosen (send_live_comment opens the Stars box with then_send=true), pick an amount above the balance, press the button.
effect: submit_live_stars_box takes the box, stores stars_before_top_up and chosen_stars but not then_send; after the top-up the comment is not sent and the user must press Send again. If live_top_up is refused for an agent input, stars_before_top_up stays set with no box.
fix: Model the Stars flow as one enum (BoxOpen{mode,stars,then_send}, TopUp{mode,stars,then_send}, Idle) so the top-up stage carries then_send and has a cancel exit.

title: send_story_reply clears the typed reply and closes the row even when the driver refused the send
trigger: Type a story reply, press Send while the send fails (get Err from driver.send_story_reply: no chats path, story gone, slow mode; the text path has no slow_mode_blocked check unlike sticker/GIF/voice).
effect: The error note shows but reply_input.set_value("") and end_story_reply run unconditionally, so the user's text is lost and the row closes as if it had been sent.
fix: Clear the field and end the reply only on Ok (match the result once, as finish_story_reply_media does for media).

title: A story opened over an open viewer keeps the reply and live-comment draft of the story it replaced
trigger: In story A type text in the reply field (or the live comment field), then press the 'Reposted from' label (press_story_repost -> open_story -> start_story_viewer), or return from the live PiP into another story. Open the reply row on the new story.
effect: start_story_viewer calls leave_story_item (closes the row) but never clear_story_fields; only story_changed (step/jump) and release_story_viewer clear them. The old draft shows in the new story's reply field and Send delivers it to the other poster.
fix: Make 'the viewer shows another story' one place (a replace_item/switch that always runs leave_item plus clear_story_fields when the key differs) used by start_story_viewer and story_changed alike.
